---
title: 'Mobile shadcn_flutter migration'
description: 'Component mapping, batch order, codemod and ratchet for removing shadcn_flutter from apps/mobile.'
---

`apps/mobile` is replacing `shadcn_flutter` with the app-owned design system in
`lib/core/ui/` (see [Mobile design system](/build/development-tools/mobile-design-system#components-and-overlays)).
The migration runs in reviewable batches. A CI ratchet stops new imports, and
the dependency is removed once nothing imports it.

## Ratchet

`scripts/check-mobile-shadcn-imports.js` scans `apps/mobile/lib` and
`apps/mobile/test`. It treats a direct `package:shadcn_flutter` import, or an
import of an in-repo shim, as a shadcn import. The shims are
`shadcn_flutter_compat.dart`, `shadcn_material_bridge.dart`,
`shadcn_localizations_fallback.dart` and `mobile_shad_theme.dart`. Each such
file must appear in `apps/mobile/tool/shadcn_import_allowlist.txt`.

- A new importer fails with a pointer to `package:mobile/core/ui/ui.dart`.
- Every URI of every `import`/`export` directive is checked, including
  conditional `if (dart.library.x)` alternatives and relative paths to a
  shim, so neither can bypass the check.
- An allowlisted file that no longer imports shadcn also fails. Run
  `node scripts/check-mobile-shadcn-imports.js --prune` to remove migrated
  entries. The flag never adds entries.
- Entries missing from the allowlist at the base revision fail, so a PR
  cannot add an importer together with an allowlist line. CI passes the PR
  base (or the previous `main` commit) with `--base <sha>`. Locally the base
  defaults to the merge base with `origin/main`.
- When the list is empty, the check fails until `flutter pub remove
  shadcn_flutter` has run.

The check runs in the **Mobile Analysis** CI job, in `bun check:changed`
whenever mobile Dart or the allowlist changes, and as `bun check:mobile-shadcn`.
Part files (`part of`) inherit their library's import. A library is migrated
only when neither it nor any of its parts uses the prefix.

The initial allowlist (October 2026) has **325** files: 253 under `lib/` and
72 under `test/`. Counting the 139 part files, **464** files use `shad.`
identifiers.

## Component mapping

| shadcn_flutter | core/ui replacement | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `shad.Theme.of(context)` | `AppTokens.of(context)` / `context.tokens` | Same `colorScheme.*` and `typography.*` names; `radiusSm…Xl`, `brightness`. Codemod. |
| `shad.ColorScheme` roles | `AppColorTokens` | Adds `success`, `warning`, `info`. Published as a `ThemeExtension` by the appearance theme. |
| `shad.Typography` | `AppTypography` | Same sizes and weights (`small` 14, `textSmall` 14/500, `h4` 18/600…). |
| `shad.Gap(n)` | `AppGap(n)` | Follows the parent `Flex` or scroll axis. Codemod. |
| `shad.LucideIcons.x` | `LucideIcons.x` (`lucide_icons_flutter`) | Same member names. 17 brand marks and `railSymbol` map to `AppIcons.*`. Codemod. |
| `shad.PrimaryButton` / `SecondaryButton` / `OutlineButton` / `GhostButton` / `DestructiveButton` | `AppButton.primary` / `.secondary` / `.outline` / `.ghost` / `.destructive` | Keeps `child`, `onPressed`, `leading`, `trailing`, `density`, `size`, `shape`, `enabled`, `alignment`. Adds `loading`. |
| `shad.ButtonDensity.*`, `ButtonSize.*`, `ButtonShape.*` | `AppButtonDensity`, `AppButtonSize`, `AppButtonShape` | `icon`, `iconDense`, `dense`, `compact`, `comfortable` keep their meaning. |
| `shad.IconButton` | `AppIconButton(tooltip:)` | `tooltip` is required and is the accessible name. |
| `shad.TextField` / `shad.TextArea` | `AppTextField` (`maxLines: null` for areas) | `placeholder` is a `String`. `InputFeature.leading/trailing` become `leading`/`trailing`. Keep `contextMenuBuilder` call sites on `PlatformTextContextMenu`. |
| Search inputs | `AppSearchField`, or `AppSheetSearch` in sheets | Shell pages and sheets register dynamic search instead of inline fields. |
| `shad.Card` / `shad.SurfaceCard` | `AppCard` (`elevated: true`) | Use `AppGroupedSection` for settings-style rows. |
| `shad.OutlineBadge` / `PrimaryBadge` / `SecondaryBadge` / `DestructiveBadge` | `AppBadge(variant:)` / `AppBadge.outline` | Adds `success`/`warning`. |
| `shad.Alert(destructive:)` | `AppAlert(variant:)` / `AppAlert.destructive` | Live region; `info`, `success`, `warning` variants. |
| `shad.Divider` / `VerticalDivider` | `AppDivider` / `AppDivider.vertical` | |
| `shad.Switch` | `AppSwitch` | Adaptive; pass `semanticLabel` when no visible label is adjacent. |
| `shad.Checkbox` + `CheckboxState` | `AppCheckbox(value: bool?)` | `checked` → `true`, `unchecked` → `false`, `indeterminate` → `null` with `tristate`. |
| `shad.Select`, `DropdownMenu` (single choice) | `AppSelect<T>` | Opens an `AppOptionTile` list in `showAppSheet`. |
| `shad.Tooltip` | `AppTooltip` | |
| `shad.showToast` / `ToastOverlay` | `showAppToast` | Sits above the dock clearance; one at a time. |
| `shad.AlertDialog`, `compat.showDialog` | `showAppDialog` + `AppDialog`, `showAppConfirmDialog` | Correct Back semantics. |
| `openDrawer`, `showAdaptiveDrawer`, `showAdaptiveSheet`, `AppDialogScaffold` | `showAppSheet` + `AppSheetScaffold` | `showAdaptiveSheet` already uses `AppModalBinding` and remains a compatibility path. |
| `shad.Scaffold` | `AppScaffold` | Transparent inside the shell. `headers` only for full-screen flows above it. |
| `shad.AppBar` (outside shell chrome) | `AppTopBar` | Inside the shell, register title and actions with the shell instead. |
| `shad.NavigationItem`, `NavigationBar`, `Tabs`/`TabItem` | Shell dock (`MorphingNavigationBar`), mini-nav, Material `TabBar` styled with tokens | Shell batch. |
| `shad.FormKey`, `FormField`, `MenuButton`, `DatePicker`, `CalendarView`, `Slider`, `Toggle`, `LinearProgressIndicator` | Material equivalents themed with `AppTokens`, wrapped as needed | Low counts (≤15 each); migrate in their feature batch. |
| `shad.ShadcnApp.router`, `ShadcnLocalizations`, `ThemeData`, `ColorSchemes`, `ThemeMode`, `ScaffoldTheme`, `ComponentTheme` | `MaterialApp.router` with `AppearanceTheme.materialTheme`, a local `ThemeMode` | Final batch, with `app.dart`, theme cubit, appearance scope and test helpers. |

## Codemod

`scripts/mobile-shadcn-codemod.js` performs the mechanical renames on whole
libraries, including their parts:

```bash
node scripts/mobile-shadcn-codemod.js --dry-run apps/mobile/lib/features/finance
node scripts/mobile-shadcn-codemod.js apps/mobile/lib/features/finance apps/mobile/test/features/finance
cd apps/mobile && dart format lib test   # scoped paths in practice
node ../../scripts/check-mobile-shadcn-imports.js --prune
```

It rewrites `<prefix>.Gap(` → `AppGap(`, `<prefix>.Theme.of(` →
`AppTokens.of(`, and `<prefix>.LucideIcons.*` → `LucideIcons.*` or
`AppIcons.*`. It adds `package:mobile/core/ui/ui.dart` and drops the shadcn
import once neither the library nor its parts use the prefix. The codemod covers
1,705 icons, 1,282 gaps and 770 theme reads, about 3,750 of the 5,270 prefixed
uses. A dry run over the whole app touches 322 files. Afterwards, 263 files
still import shadcn (62 freed).

After running it, fix values passed into APIs typed `shad.ThemeData`, then
run `flutter analyze` and the feature's tests on the remote validation lane.
Replace the remaining ~1,500 widget uses by hand with the table above.

## Batch order

Each batch is one PR, or one layer of a native stack, owned by one lane. Run
the codemod for its folders, migrate the remaining widgets, prune the
allowlist, and attach renders for changed screens. LOC and counts cover every
file that uses `shad.`, parts included.

| Phase | Scope | Files | LOC | Icons / Gap / Theme | Manual uses |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Codemod sweep across all folders (mechanical only, no widget swaps) | 322 | ~148k touched | 1,705 / 1,282 / 770 | 0 |
| 2 | `core`, `widgets`, `app_version`, `mobile_versions`, `desktop_update`, `onboarding`, `counter` and their tests: shared surfaces first | 52 | 12.1k | 1,520 / 42 / 28 | 165 |
| 3 | `settings`, `profile`, `security`, `auth` and tests (coordinate with the settings lane) | 92 | 23.0k | 75 / 193 / 120 | 224 |
| 4 | `finance`, `inventory`, `storefront` and tests | 61 | 26.1k | 0 / 378 / 160 | 226 |
| 5 | `tasks_boards`, `task_portfolio`, `tasks_estimates`, `tasks`, `task_planning` and tests | 75 | 28.0k | 21 / 349 / 216 | 394 |
| 6 | `time_tracker`, `habits`, `calendar`, `reminders` and tests | 69 | 23.9k | 58 / 251 / 119 | 254 |
| 7 | `assistant`, `chat`, `mail`, `meet`, `notes`, `drive`, `documents`, `education`, `crm`, `cms`, `apps`, `dashboard`, `notifications`, `workspace` and tests | 82 | 24.3k | 31 / 42 / 102 | 133 |
| 8 | `shell`, `app.dart`, `bootstrap`, theme plumbing, `test/shell`, `test/helpers`, `test/app` | 33 | 10.8k | 0 / 27 / 25 | 118 |
| 9 | Removal: delete the shims, `flutter pub remove shadcn_flutter`, drop the allowlist file and its CI step | — | small | — | — |

Phases 2–7 can run in parallel after phase 1 merges, because they touch
disjoint folders. Phase 8 waits for 2–7. Large features (`tasks_boards`,
`time_tracker`, `finance`) should be split by sub-folder into stack layers of
about 10–15 files.

## Final removal

1. Allowlist empty (`--prune` leaves only the header).
2. Delete `core/widgets/shadcn_flutter_compat.dart`,
   `shadcn_material_bridge.dart`, `shadcn_localizations_fallback.dart` and
   `core/theme/mobile_shad_theme.dart`. Fold `AppearanceTheme.colorScheme`
   into `AppColorTokens` directly.
3. `flutter pub remove shadcn_flutter`, then `flutter pub get`, then analyze and
   test on the validation lane.
4. Remove the ratchet step from `.github/workflows/mobile.yaml`, the
   `check-changed` plan entry, the script, its test and the allowlist file.
5. Update this page and the mobile skill reference to mark the migration
   complete.
